description: JavaScript functions for managing checkboxes in a web application's UI, including bulk check/uncheck, counting checked boxes, setting values based on checkbox states, and platform-specific checkbox toggling.

methods.name: box
methods.description: Sets all checkboxes within a specified div to a given checked/unchecked state.

methods.name: checkAll
methods.description: Checks all checkboxes in a specified form or container.

methods.name: uncheckAll
methods.description: Unchecks all checkboxes in a specified form or container.

methods.name: checkOrUncheckAll
methods.description: Helper function to check or uncheck all checkboxes within a form.

methods.name: checkbox_count_checked
methods.description: Counts how many checkboxes are checked within a container.

methods.name: set_combo_if_checkbox
methods.description: Sets the value of related combo boxes based on checked checkboxes.

methods.name: set_checkbox
methods.description: Sets a specific checkbox's checked state.

methods.name: checkbox_get_checked
methods.description: Alerts when a checked checkbox is found within a specified element.

methods.name: cs_all_checkbox_in_div
methods.description: Toggles all checkboxes with a specific prefix within a div, based on a stored memory value.

methods.name: cs_all_checkbox_in_div_with_platform
methods.description: Toggles checkboxes within a div based on platform_id, supporting platform-specific bulk toggle.
